{{Field procedure|summary=Launch and read prospector limpets to identify asteroid contents before committing time and collector limpets.}}

Use this procedure whenever a mining run needs to choose worthwhile asteroids instead of extracting blindly.

{{Draft warning}}

== Before you start ==

* Fit and power a [[Prospector Limpet Controller]].
* Load limpets into cargo before leaving a station or carrier.
* Decide what the run is looking for: a commodity, a core asteroid, sub-surface deposits, or general learning practice.
* Keep enough distance from the asteroid that the limpet has a clear path.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Select a candidate asteroid visually, by hotspot position, or by the search pattern for the chosen method.
# Point the ship so the prospector limpet has a clear launch path.
# Launch one prospector limpet at the asteroid.
# Wait for the limpet to attach and complete its scan.
# Read the asteroid contents, deposit information, and any method-specific signals shown by the prospector result.
# Decide whether the asteroid is worth mining before deploying collectors or spending ammunition.
# Move to another asteroid if the contents do not match the run's goal.
}}

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when the commander has a prospector result and has either committed to mining the asteroid or moved on deliberately.

== Common problems ==

* '''The limpet misses or dies:''' slow down, face the asteroid more cleanly, and avoid launching into nearby rock.
* '''The asteroid has low-value contents:''' skip it; the prospector is doing its job by saving time.
* '''The controller will not launch:''' check module power, fire group assignment, available limpets, and whether another active prospector is already using the controller's capacity.
* '''Collectors are launched too early:''' prospect first, then collect after the asteroid is worth working.
